hotels.vendor_name: The Royal Sands Koh Rong Resort
hotels.title: Cambodia Island Luxury with All-Inclusive Dining & Daily Three-Hour Free-Flow Cocktails
hotels.description: Set along 550 metres of pristine white sand on Cambodia's western shore, The Royal Sands Koh Rong is a secluded island retreat surrounded by tropical beauty. Stay in a villa crafted from locally sourced teak, bamboo and limestone, with an outdoor sala lounge and views across the Gulf of Thailand. For an even more indulgent escape, upgrade to an Ocean View Pool Villa or Beachfront Pool Villa with your own private swimming pool. Spend days swimming, kayaking or paddleboarding in the clear coastal waters, or simply settle into the soft sands and let island time take over. At Senses Spa, unwind in a private treatment room featuring glass floors overlooking a tranquil koi pond, while the resort’s fitness centre and yoga sala offer ways to stay active. With panoramic ocean views, tropical gardens and a peaceful beachfront setting, The Royal Sands Koh Rong makes it wonderfully easy to settle into island life.
